title: Chalet Chardons
summary: Turning a week of kitchen operations into a reusable digital training course. I filmed, edited and produced the video and web delivery, with a later expansion into housekeeping training.
credit: Content and recipes by head chef Maciek 'Magic' Dolasinski. Filming, editing, motion graphics and website by Stephen Howe.

title: Book Your Wellness
summary: Interface and page-layout work for a wellness marketplace, alongside ongoing web management and user-experience improvements for international leisure clients.
credit: Freelance interface and graphic design. Shown as historical project material.

media.alt: Book Your Wellness sign-up page design

title: Qtac
summary: A support role grew into responsibility for redesigning the company website. Product knowledge from handling payroll-software support informed the site structure, graphics and implementation.
credit: Website redesign and implementation by Stephen Howe while employed at Qtac. Images are archived captures with the limitations of the original snapshots.

title: Burger Theory
summary: From early pop-ups to festival trading: website implementation in HTML and CSS, promotional materials and an ongoing web and social presence for a growing street-food business.
credit: Core brand identity and supplied website visual design by the founder's father. Website implementation, promotional graphics and web/social management by Stephen Howe.

title: Hot Biscuit
summary: Programming, promotion and design across three Brighton music venues. The work connected posters and event listings with artist liaison and live-event delivery.
credit: Promotional design by Stephen Howe as Venue & Promotions Manager. Historical print work, shown as originally made.

title: 412 Promotions
summary: Design and brand management for an independent shop and online culture publication: web graphics, editorial, event photography, promotional design and managing contributing writers.
credit: Design and editorial work by Stephen Howe as Brand Manager. This selection shows surviving print and promotional material.
